doc: Sign contract between the ballast planner and the closed-loop controller. Revised 2026-05-04 for pump-first operation after onset sign-flip and FF diagnostics.

planner_frame.name: compensation_direction
planner_frame.meaning: The vector pressure_proxy_vec(uv) * pressure_sign_multiplier points in the direction ballast must move to oppose wind-induced pitch/roll. action_vec() and all planner cost terms (residual, envelope, terminal) are evaluated in this frame.
planner_frame.rationale_source: outputs/wind_prediction/planner_a1_dryrun/diagnostics/a01_pressure_vec_sign_convention.json (A0 calibration: minimizes |pitch|+|roll| residual when ballast moves in this direction).

setpoint_frame.name: setpoint_shift
setpoint_frame.meaning: The pitch_bias_deg / roll_bias_deg consumed by ClosedLoopPolicy is added to the controller setpoint. Pump-first operation uses the sign that empirically relaxes PI effort and reduces pump work, while attitude-first diagnostics may flip the sign to amplify corrective pumping.
setpoint_frame.rationale_source: outputs/wind_prediction/planner_a2_onset_signflip/signflip_report.md (2026-05-04: signpos d_pump_total=-1.34% with d_pitch_1h_p95=+0.007deg; signneg improves pitch by millidegrees but increases pump_total by +1.25%).

implementation.transformation: target_pitch_deg = planner_first_avec[0] * setpoint_bias_sign  (and same for roll)
implementation.do_not_change_planner_internals: Flipping pressure_sign_multiplier to +1 would break A0-calibrated cost geometry. Keep planner_frame as compensation_direction; choose the provider boundary sign according to the active objective.

operational_ceiling.interpretation: The setpoint-shift channel is a weak pump-saving relaxation path, not a high-authority attitude controller. FF and signneg are retained as diagnostics because they improve pitch only by spending more pump work.
